item.title: Incarico post-doc: Business model transformation in the hospitality and tourism sector (IULM - MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-09 23:59
Institution: IULM - MILANO, Milano
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-06 Economia aziendale

Digital technology and sustainability are transforming tourism. Responding to these drivers of change requires the synergistic involvement of DMOs, hospitality and catering businesses, which are harnessing digital technologies – and AI in particular – to drive innovation. The research project analyses the evolution of business models in tourism, examining business processes of experience design and the co-creation of experiences with consumers. The aim is to generate greater insight into the nature of the change currently taking place, understanding how it can deliver benefits for businesses, consumers and destinations. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Postdoctoral assignment - Circular and Digital Innovation for Resilient and Competitive Local agri-food EcosystemS – CIRCLES (Univ. VENEZIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-20 13:00
Institution: Univ. VENEZIA, Venezia
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-07 Economia e gestione delle imprese

Simplified measurement and digital management of the environmental footprint in the wine supply chain. The project entails: 1) the critical evaluation of current quality and environmental sustainability certification systems for products; 2) the integration of data collected by companies during previous production process monitoring activities; 3) the proposal of simplified methodologies for assessing the environmental footprint of wine sector products; 4) the analysis of digital solutions available for collecting environmental footprint data at the supply chain level; 5) the definition of digital logics and architectures to support the strategic and managerial upgrading of supply chains,…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Evolution of Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) schemes and packaging producers’ obligations across EU Member States following Regulation (EU) 2025/40: comparative analysis, producer fees and recovery and recycling performance. (Univ. TUSCIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. TUSCIA, Viterbo
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-10 Scienze merceologiche

The position is part of a European-scale research project co-funded by CONAI under the Implementing Agreement of 10/09/2026, aimed at updating CONAI’s “Packaging for Europe – P4EU” portal and at producing information notes for companies. The entry into force of Regulation (EU) 2025/40 (PPWR) requires Member States to adapt their packaging management models – EPR schemes and the related Producer Responsibility Organisations (PROs), deposit return systems (DRS) and tax systems – with direct implications for the obligations and fees borne by producers.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: The analysis and evaluation of the cultural politics in Italy (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-26 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/STAT-03 Demografia e statistica sociale

The research aims to develop composite economic and social indicators for evaluating a series of cultural policy measures within the Italian context. It intends to carry out a quantitative analysis of the efficiency and effectiveness of public spending measures in the field of culture. For the purposes of this research, the most relevant demographic, economic, and social dimensions identified by the sector's literature will be taken into consideration.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Financial Flexibility as strategic factor for Portfolio Management (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-15 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-09 Economia degli intermediari finanziari e finanza aziendale

The study will investigate the role of Financial Flexibility as a strategic determinant of Portfolio Management, assessing whether firms’ ability to withstand shocks and financial constraints can represent a source of resilience and competitive advantage. Using dynamic asset allocation models, the research will examine whether this characteristic enables investors to capitalize on opportunities during periods of market stress and generate excess returns relative to the market

item.title: Incarico post-doc: COMPETITION FOR N.1 POST DOC ASSIGNMENT, GROUPS 13/STEC-01 ECONOMIC HISTORY - HISTORY OF ECONOMICS AND 11/HIST-02 MODERN HISTORY AT “BAFFI” RESEARCH CENTER AT UNIVERSITÀ COMMERCIALE “LUIGI BOCCONI” DI MILANO (Univ. Bocconi MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 23:59
Institution: Univ. Bocconi MILANO, Milano
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/STEC-01 Storia dell'economia

The MOLDisTory project studies the role of merchant-bankers and the interconnection between trade and financial intermediation in early modern Europe (XVI-XVII century), using unique primary data from the archives of the Bank of San Giorgio. The holder of the Research Assignment will be in charge of the following activities. • Systematic transcription of archival sources, particularly the customs and banking sources of the Bank of San Giorgio. • Study of archival sources and their functional relationships. • Exploring machine learning techniques for handwritten text recognition. • Digitization of archival sources in collaboration with external companies and officials of the State Archives.…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Brand Experience and Consumer Well-being in Digital Environments: Branding Strategies for Shared Value Creation (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-14 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-07 Economia e gestione delle imprese

This research lies at the intersection of brand strategy and consumer behavior in digital experiential contexts, aiming to investigate how brands can pursue their strategic objectives by fully leveraging technological potential while simultaneously protecting and enhancing consumer well-being. By employing mixed (qualitative and quantitative) methodological approaches, the project aims to develop a framework to support the planning of branding strategies in digital environments, exploring the conditions that allow brand goals to be reconciled with the psychological well-being of the consumer.
